text:
sara: Quick check — ACME SI asked for the final pen-test artifact bundle for our cloud marketplace listing. They need the pen-test PDF, sanitized scan CSV, and the SOC2 overview. Timeline: marketplace reviewers expect signoff by Wed EOD. Who owns redaction + presign? :eyes:

derek: I can own the redaction and sanitization. Do we have the approved redaction checklist or a template? I want to avoid leaking IP/customer PII.

leah: For the HW partner component (vendor provided HSM certs), we also need the vendor attestation and a checksum. Vendor sent encrypted tarball earlier — need to decrypt into a staging bucket before redaction.

kyle: Legal heads-up: ensure NDAs cover SI sharing and we do not publish any raw customer logs. Also need the short attestation blurb for the listing (one sentence). I'll draft.

sara: Cool — owners: @derek (security) = redaction, @leah (eng) = HSM cert + decrypt, @jessica (partnerships) = upload/presign + marketplace contact.

jessica: I'll upload sanitized artifacts to the marketplace evidence bucket. Presign window should be 14 days for reviewers. Use this presign pattern: ```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/ACME-pen-test.pdf --expires-in 1209600``` I'll paste links when done.

derek: Redaction notes: remove stack traces, obfuscate IPs, redact email strings and any customer IDs. For vulnerability CSV, include only CVE + status + remediation summary (no internal system names).

marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace evidence retention policy requires artifacts be accessible for at least 90 days for audit reviewers.

leah: Ops note: decrypt command I'll use (KMS): ```aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://vendor.tar.gz.enc --output text --query Plaintext | base64 --decode > vendor.tar.gz``` then quarantine in staging bucket `s3://redwood-staging/marketplace/ACME/` before redaction. Need infra perms for that.

kyle: Draft attestation for listing: "Redwood Inference and ACME SI attest that the artifacts provided are sanitized and do not contain customer-identifiable data." I'll put a short version in #legal-drafts.

sara: Proposed schedule: Derek completes redaction by Tue 12:00, Jessica uploads & presigns by Tue 18:00, Leah confirms HSM cert + checksum by Wed 10:00, Kyle posts attestation by Wed 14:00. If any slippage >4 hours escalate to @lina-sales and @tom-ops.

jessica: Will notify here with presigned links. Also want to confirm reviewer emails so we can restrict presign access to their accounts (if marketplace supports).

derek: Quick redaction utility example for logs: `sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,6}/[redacted-email]/g' logs/*.log` and `sed -E 's/(\b\d{1,3}(?:\.]\d{1,3}){3}\b)/[redacted-ip]/g'` — we'll run in a container and commit the sanitized bundle.

leah: I'll request decryption IAM role from eng-infra now. If infra can't approve fast, we may need vendor to re-upload plaintext to our secure upload form (less ideal).

kyle: Also confirm: do we need an independent pen-test attestation (signed by the 3rd-party tester)? If yes, ask the SI to include the tester's statement in the bundle.

sara: Yes include tester attestation if available — that speeds review. OK folks, quick huddle in 10 to confirm handoffs? :phone:

jessica: +1, joining. I'll prep the presign command and the bucket path and drop them in thread after upload. :thumbsup:
